data.summary: Lane template approval has no working command: launch_template.consent tells the person to run `ddflow approvals request` for a subject and digest, but that command takes only verb, --item, --target and --reason; launch_template.approve is the only writer of an approval.granted for a lane-template subject and it has no caller, so approved() can never pass outside a test
data.title: Lane template approval has no working command

data.body:
Fixes bug B8647b69e06: Lane template approval has no working command: launch_template.consent tells the person to run `ddflow approvals request` for a subject and digest, but that command takes only verb, --item, --target and --reason; launch_template.approve is the only writer of an approval.granted for a lane-template subject and it has no caller, so approved() can never pass outside a test Found on SW-launch.

Write the regression test first and watch it FAIL on the unfixed code; then `ddflow complete fix-B8647b69e06 --regression-test <test>` closes the bug with the task (or `ddflow bug fixed B8647b69e06 --regression-test <test>` first).
data.title: Fix bug B8647b69e06: Lane template approval has no working command
